task: Predict the entire set of new/change orders in hours 6-12 from information available at hour 6
output: Structured orders compiled from training-derived joint drug/route/dose/unit/frequency templates; catalogue-constrained, not unconstrained generation
vocabulary: Existing 128 raw normalized drug names, fitted on initial 8000 training admissions; all out-of-vocabulary gold remains scored
candidate_tool: Frozen 40000-case supervised candidate ranker and conditional joint-order compiler from seed 42; shared by all LLM methods
candidate_order: Alphabetical, without displaying rank or probability
decoding: greedy; no hidden fallback prescriptions; malformed output counted
selection: Train-ground-truth reflection proposes conditional procedural skill. Retain only if proposal composite strictly improves and guard drug-F1 and Core4-F1 do not decrease. No test-label feedback.
test_exposure: 1082-case test was previously evaluated by historical supervised pipelines. This is an exploratory new-method evaluation, not a pristine benchmark.
evolution: Procedural memory changes only; base LLM weights and supervised tools remain frozen. Rejected mutations remain reported.

comparators.saferx: Independent three-call task adaptation of specialty/supportive drafting, critique, flag adjudication; not author code
comparators.skemex: Author memory encoding/retrieval core with local backend and common prescription actor; task/backend adaptation
comparators.flame: Audit and attempt released checkpoint inference; do not substitute an untrained prompt for step-wise GRPO
